# Account Hub password names separate custom tags, template IDs and localized UI identifiers

The password step keeps email-password-form.mjs/custom tag, EmailPasswordForm class, accountHubEmailPasswordFormTemplate ID/include name, passwordForm/rememberPassword DOM IDs and account-hub-password-label Fluent ID. The paired browser_accountHub.js test uses descriptive test_account_enter_password_imap_account. Preserve these existing local namespaces and descriptive scenario names; these examples do not establish that all Thunderbird test filenames or task functions share one case rule. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mail/components/accountcreation.
